title.en: An Act Amending Certain Items in Republic Act Numbered Twelve Hundred, Entitled “An Act Appropriating Funds for Public Works and Amending Republic Act Numbered Nine Hundred and Twenty”
title.orig: An Act Amending Certain Items in Republic Act Numbered Twelve Hundred, Entitled “An Act Appropriating Funds for Public Works and Amending Republic Act Numbered Nine Hundred and Twenty”

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_2007_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Items (153) and (156), under paragraph "aa. Leyte," section two of Republic Act Numbered Twelve hundred are amended to read as follows:
"(153) Construction of Home Economics Building, Central School, Capoocan ₱10,000.00" "(156) Construction of upper Caghalo Barrio School, Carigara 10,000.00"

Under paragraph "aa. Leyte," section two of the same Act, the following item, to be known as item (162), is inserted:
"(162) Construction of San Vicente Barrio School Building, Alang-alang ₱20,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1957.
